keys.key: src/modules/journeys/journeys.service.ts:619 · updateStep · an explicit null in a nullable field (description, plannedDurationHours, startedAt, dueAt, completedAt, gamify) is skipped like undefined instead of clearing the field, so the update silently preserves it · reached via src/modules/journeys/journeys.controller.ts:406 (PATCH step body {"dueAt": null}; updateStepSchema, journeys.dto.ts:208, allows null on those fields)

src/modules/journeys/journey-edits.planner.ts:389 · setStepDueDate · the unchanged check compares toDateString() instead of getTime(), so a same-day due-time change is treated as no change and dropped from the plan · reached via src/modules/agent/tools/journey.tools.ts:298 (an edit_journey set_step_due_date operation with the same date and a different time; the schema takes any date)

findings.effect: The new loop skips null values instead of adding them to unsetFields, so PATCH requests can no longer clear description, plannedDurationHours, startedAt, dueAt, completedAt, or gamify. Users receive a success response, but the old value stays.
findings.reason: Names the seeded service file, locates the null-skipping loop within two lines, and describes nullable fields silently retaining their values.

findings.effect: Comparing calendar days drops due-date changes that only change the time, causing the whole batch to fail with no_change if that is the only operation. The comparison also uses the server's local timezone, so whether two instants count as the same day depends on where the server runs.
findings.reason: Names the seeded planner file and exact line and describes same-day due-time changes being dropped.

findings.effect: set_step_due_date compares only the calendar day in the server's local timezone, so a time change within the same day is rejected as no_change. Whether two instants count as the same day also depends on the server's timezone.
findings.reason: Names the seeded planner file, quotes the seeded comparison, and describes same-day due-time changes being rejected as no_change.

findings.effect: The PATCH step endpoint silently ignores null instead of clearing description, plannedDurationHours, startedAt, dueAt, completedAt and gamify. Existing values remain stored, breaking the contract for clearing these fields.
findings.reason: Names the seeded service file, quotes the null-skipping condition, and describes PATCH requests failing to clear nullable fields.

findings.effect: Proposal and application each generate new step ids, so stepId values in add_step and add_section previews never match the ids stored. This causes trouble if the frontend or a later turn refers to those preview ids.
findings.reason: Proposal and application independently run the planner with fresh ObjectIds, so exposed preview stepIds do not identify the persisted steps and subsequent references to them fail.
